notes.title: Happy Halloween! New update Online.
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Just wanted to wish you all a Happy Halloween and wanted to let you know that a new update is online that fixes a lot of issues that were present in the game.

Also please delete your old saved games as they will cause a conflict with the latest version and if needed delete the entire game and reinstall the new version as it might cause conflicts as well.

Below are the file paths for the saved game files:

Windows: C:\Users\Your_Username\AppData\LocalLow\SkobbejakGames\

Mac: /Library/Caches/SkobbejakGames/
OR
/Library/Application Support/SkobbejakGames/

Linux: /home/[username]/.config/unity3d/SkobbejakGames/

We apologise for the inconvenience and we hope you enjoy the new update.

Please let us know what you think.

Kind Regards,
Skobbejak Games

notes.title: Big Update inbound very soon. Vapour 2 now on Steam Greenlight.
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We just wanted to give you all a heads up that we have a big update incoming for Vapour: Part 1 that should fix a lot of issues and improve the game overall, we are hard at work to get it ready for you all this weekend, we apologize for the wait and we will be sure to make it worth your time :)

Also a heads up, the Steam Greenlight Campaign for Vapour 2 has just launched, please check it out, give us your support as soon as you get some time and please be sure to let us know what you think.

Vapour 2 Steam Greenlight: http://bit.ly/2flviS7

Thanks again for all the support and feedback everyone, we really appreciate it and we hope you are looking forward to the new Vapour: Part 1 update and Vapour 2 as well.

Regards,
Skobbejak Games

notes.title: Check out our latest Steam Greenlight project. Update for Vapour:Part 1 coming soon. More news coming soon.
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

we just wanted to let you all know that we have a new game on Steam Greenlight, Oop See.

The game is a Pirate-themed Arcade Shooter, with VR support and you can find more info on it and vote for it here:

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=755541257

We will also be releasing a big patch update for Vapour: Part 1 soon in time for Halloween which will fix all the framerate issues and other bugs.

Stay tuned as there is also more Vapour news planned for Halloween.

Thanks so much for all your support everyone, we really appreciate it.

- Controller support added.
- Issues with resolution drop down in Grpahics settings has been fixed.
- Multiple small bug fixes.

We will update the Updates Roadmap accordingly.

The next Patch update will be addressing all the necessary Performance Optimisations as well as bug fixes for any other problems that are still present.

Thanks again for all the love, support and patience everyone, we truly appreciate it :)

notes.title: Patch Update #3
notes.notes:
Hi everyone Patch#3 is out and her are the additions:

-Mouse Sensitivity controls added under Control Settings in the Options Menu
-Mouse Invert controls added under Control Settings in the Options Menu 
-Some General Compatibility Fixes
-Some bug fixes

We will update the Roadmap accordingly.

As always thanks for all the love, support and feedback :)


*(Please Note: There is a conflict between the "Camera Zoom" action and Invert Mouse Movement, when the camera is in zoomed mode it will switch to non-Inverted, try to keep a higher Mouse Sensitivity and move slowly if you awant to use the Camera Zoom with Inverted Mouse movement comfortably. This is connected to a plugin we are using and we are working to solve this asap, apologies for the inconvenience)*

notes.title: Vapour: Part 1 [Patch Update #2]
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

The 2nd Patch update for Vapour: Part 1 has been released, here are the following additions and fixes:

-English Subtitles
-Optional Objective Hints (can be turned on/off at will)
-Trading Cards
-Some Collider Fixes
-Some additional minor fixes


As a recap here are all the changes that were made in the previous (first) Patch Update:

-Some perfomance Optimisations (V-Sync now disabled by default, but can         be toggled)
-Shorter Loading times for deaths and loading areas
-Story intro can now be skipped when starting a new game
-Graphics settings menu added
-Some Small Changes/Fixes
-Item/Weapon/Health Guide.

We will update the Updates Roadmap in the Community Hub accordingly.

notes.title: First Patch update for Vapour: Part 1
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Just wanted to let you all know that we updated Vapour: Part 1 with a few patch fixes and improvements. Here is the list of changes included in the first update:

-Some Performance Optimisations
-Shorter Loading times for deaths and loading areas
-Story intro can now be skipped when starting a new game
-Graphics settings menu added
-Some Small Changes
-Item/Weapon/Health Guide.

Thanks again to everyone for all the feedback so far, we are jumping on the 2nd update right away so that we can get Vapour: Part 1 polished up as much as possible.

If you want to keep track of the progress of these updates you can check out the Updates Roadmap in the Cummunity Hub. Also if you have any suggestions on changes you would like to see, be sure to let us know.

Thanks again for all the support everyone, hope you enjoy the new changes we will try and get the next update out as thouroughly and quickly as possible.
